title: Make paid rendering and fallback policy explicit
description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Given an author submitting work to Babulus, when paid cloud fallback is enabled, then configured limits and pricing/estimate policy are visible before submission. Local-only mode never silently falls back to paid rendering. Record local versus cloud execution and usage for billing; implement the fixed pilot pricing and ledger defined in D12.

## Ownership
Babulus rendering platform; VideoML public project/artifact contract

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.

## Implementation handoff
Do not dispatch this broad story directly. Dispatch the bounded Terra packets under this milestone: videoml-f708b4, videoml-e97334, videoml-e68602, videoml-5fd757, videoml-54b377, videoml-96c59f. Binding contracts/defaults and review gates are in initiative videoml-dbc2b1 D01–D15. Story closure requires all relevant packet evidence and primary review.
